english.title: Possess with intent to supply a controlled drug of Class A - Other
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..)]_
(B)_[a quantity]_

of **(..SPECIFY A DRUG NOT SPECIFICALLY CATERED FOR..), a controlled drug of class A, with intent to supply it to **(..SPECIFY NAME..) in contravention of section 4(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section5(3) of, and Schedule4 to, the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order
Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence wording should only be used for a Class 'A' drug NOT specifically catered for as follows:
H2322 Cocaine, H2323 Heroin, H2324 LSD , H2325 MDMA (ecstasy), H2492 "Crack" cocaine or H2493 Methadone.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum life imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

A minimum sentence of seven years may apply to a third class A drug trafficking offence, see section 313 of the Sentencing Act 2020 and paragraph 1 of Schedule 2 to the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
